title: OperationalMetrics
description: HAR-145: what one agent run (and so its DecisionEpisode) cost to produce: model calls, tokens, tool calls, retries, latency by stage and cost, summed from the usage the model worker reports on every response and core stores per call (run_model_usage). These are the operational diagnostics M1-M5 (token efficiency, tool efficiency, eval overhead, latency, cost) of the HAR-97 registry: a METRIC, never an EVAL. `classification` is always metric and nothing here has a verdict, pass or fail. Counts are exact sums of what the worker reported; a field the provider did not report is not guessed: cached_input_tokens, reasoning_tokens and cost_usd are null unless every model call reported them, and a null is shown as "not measured", never as 0 or as a free run. Tokens of a model answer that was discarded and retried are not reported (the attempt is in retries), so token sums are a lower bound when retries > 0. `usage_source` says where the answers came from: live (a real provider; the figures are what it reported), replay (recorded cassettes, nothing spent) or mixed. Replayed calls are never summed: `measured` is true only when at least one live call was recorded, and false (every number 0 or null, no stages) for a run with no usage recorded (from before usage capture, one that made no model call) or one that was only replayed.

measured.description: True only when live usage was recorded for the run; false for a run with no usage or a replay-only run.

usage_source.description: Where the recorded answers came from; null when no usage was recorded for the run.

model_calls.description: Provider completions whose answer the worker used; a discarded and retried attempt is counted in retries, not here. Replayed calls are not counted.

cached_input_tokens.description: The part of input_tokens served from the provider's prompt cache; null (not measured) unless every live model call reported it.

reasoning_tokens.description: The part of output_tokens spent on hidden reasoning; null (not measured) unless every live model call reported it.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls the model asked for, as counted by the worker.

context_pulls.description: GET /internal/ctx pulls core logged for the run (context_access_log): core's own count of the same activity.

retries.description: Extra provider attempts: rate-limit backoffs, an invalid-output retry, a fallback-model switch.

cost_usd.description: Sum of the provider-reported cost; null (show "not measured") unless every recorded live model call reported one. Never an estimate, and never reported for replayed calls.

worker_call_ms.description: Sum of core's measured duration of each live worker call. It is NOT the run's elapsed time: concurrent calls add up and the time between calls (core's own work, waiting for the human) is not in it.

model_ms.description: Sum of the time the worker spent inside the provider layer, per live call; concurrent calls add up.

stages.description: The same sums by worker operation (the latency stages), in the order they first ran.

stage.description: The worker operation. judge is the semantic-eval overhead (M3).

worker_calls.description: Worker HTTP calls of this operation.
